description: nhflow_2d_si_kato_phillips_kepsilon with the algebraic eddy viscosity A 547 1 1e-6 and its stability functions (A 623 1: Munk and Anderson, nu = nu_n (1 + 10 Ri)^-1/2, K = nu_n/sigma_t (1 + 3.33 Ri)^-3/2, A 625). The depth of the largest N^2 is within 10 % of Price (1979) (16 ... 50 m against 15 ... 45 m over 30 h); without A 623 the column is mixed by 10 h (salinity range from 1.34 to 0.005 psu; the parabolic profile spans the whole depth).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::eddy_algebraic with A 623 (stability functions, the tracer diffusivity KV)
nhflow_tracer_SI: the vertical diffusivity from KV
